provenance.what: the text detector's answers on inputs small enough to commit: PaddleX's preprocessing and DB postprocessing, and the OpenCV and pyclipper calls inside them
provenance.recorded_by: M29 P4, a scratch script calling paddlex 3.7.2's text_detection processors (DetResizeForTest, NormalizeImage, DBPostProcess with the OCR pipeline's arguments), cv2 4.10.0 and pyclipper 1.4.0, under numpy 2.3.5
provenance.cross_check: the same processors, built directly, reproduce the live predictor's input tensor on a bay working image bit for bit
provenance.scene: rectify/scene.png; cv2 reads it as BGR, which is what PaddleX's detector sees
provenance.sha256: of the values row-major: f32 little-endian for tensors, one byte per value for images and masks

postprocess.map: det/pred_crop.png: rows 320.. and columns 352.. of 2026-08-23-10's probability map (frozen Paddle), times 255 and rounded; each value is read back as float32(k) / float32(255)
